source.rationale: A promotion row need not carry a `title`. Both the roster label and the unmet-token join fall back to the row's own 'Promotion' field, and a row with neither gets the ordinal placeholder 'promotion N' rather than an empty label the customer cannot refer to. The join is what is really under test: ALPHA is shown (so its token contributed and must NOT be reported unmet) while BETA is not — if the field fallback broke, NOTHING would look contributed, the miss would read as total, and the per-item note would silently disappear.
source.repin_rationale: RE-PINNED for the team-name DISPLAY fix (captain 2026-08-24). An internal team slug was rendered verbatim into customer WhatsApp copy ("escalate to purchasing_certification team?"); live has been emitting "marketing_promotion_sorento team" at real customers for 4 turns in 8 days. Underscores now render as spaces at the interpolation. The ONLY difference in this expectation is 2 '_' becoming ' ' inside the team token of an escalate sentence - checked character by character (same length, same offsets, every flipped byte between "escalate to" and " team"); no other field, key or value moved. The raw slug is unchanged wherever it is routed on or persisted.
